entities.summary: Dabiq was a Raqqa-based online magazine of the Islamic State, published via the deep web from July 2014 to July 2016. One of the many forms of Islamic State mass media, it took part in religious outreach to Muslims around the world, ultimately seeking to gain new recruits for the "caliphate" by encouraging Muslims to immigrate to Islamic State territory. In addition to Arabic, the magazine's content was written in a number of different languages, including English.
